comparator.sourceNotes: Current2026–2027 B-LR English full-time bachelor programme29663 and its38current catalogue entries verify the retained22parent modules:60ECyear1,60ECyear2,30ECminor,15ECthird-year major and15ECDSE=180EC. The38entries total150ECincluding a0ECmentor component; the separate30ECminor is retained, not filled with invented content. Parent/child weights agree with the current portal-linked chart, including1ECwind-tunnel and3ECaerospaceAIwithin their parent modules. The2027redesign andMScspecialisations are excluded. IRArticle9andRRvEArticles22/24delegate published course/project requirements to the digital guide. AE2111-Irequires45year1ECincludingAE1111-I; AE2224-Irequires45year1EC,positiveBSA and both first-year projects by the statedOctoberselection, plus the named first-year maths/statics/programming preparation. AE3212-IIrequires all first/second-year projects, knowledge of structural/numerical analysis and preferably prior or parallelAE3212-I. The complete selected2026–2027AE3212-Ientry publishes no additional admission requirement; its empty admission/prior-knowledge fields are recorded as no additional requirement published, not an invented threshold. Its stale advisory sentence namingAE1201/AE2101is not converted into a formal prerequisite. Completing all first/second-year modules before the third-year major satisfies every published project requirement. CurrentAE3200explicitly gives ordinarySpringfourth-period entry to third-year students with both years complete andJanuaryselection;Fall is fourth-year-or-later only. The IRSpringheading retains an inconsistent2025–2026label, but itsJanuary2026–2027selection and the current delegatedAE3200entry establish the ordinary currentSpringroute. This is source-based interpretation, not a claimed formal erratum. The formal and guide opening weeks differ; both share the end-of-week3.1Springdeadline, and timely registration in their common window satisfies both. Follow actual announced registration notices. Minor approval/overlap rules remain as inIRArticle2. DSEis a15ECteam whole-aircraft/spacecraft/wind-turbine design exercise requiring hardware, not an unspecified individual thesis or software-only mission. Published progression is verified; this does not guarantee an individual student admission or forecast future administrative dates.
